notes.subject: נחלה
notes.rationale: Tok Pisin i no gat tok stret bilong 'inheritance'; mi tok 'wanpela samting bilong yu olsem i kamap long nem bilong yu' — suga long hap ol man i kisim long ol bargen bilong ol.

notes.subject: Tasol
notes.rationale: Waw conjunctive והם hia em i contrast (yet/but), na Tok Pisin i nidim 'Tasol' long soim dispela.

notes.subject: long Yahwe
notes.rationale: Mose i toktok direk long Yahwe long pes bilong en — em i las hap bilong prais bilong em bilong ol man Israel.

translation: Tasol ol i stap ol man bilong yu, na wanpela samting bilong yu olsem i kamap long nem bilong yu, ol yu bringautim wantaim strong bilong yu i bikpela tru, na wantaim han bilong yu i stret aut.

tokens.gloss: na wanpela samting bilong yu olsem i kamap long nem bilong yu
